mentions.name: Incidenthub.cloud
mentions.description: This B2B SaaS monitors the public status pages of third-party dependencies, tracking outages and incidents on external services that a business relies on.
mentions.problem: It was born out of a personal need in past roles and teams for keeping tabs on third-party dependency status pages.
mentions.audience: B2B SaaS for businesses that need visibility into the operational status of third-party services they depend on.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Incidenthub.cloud - a B2B SaaS that monitors public status pages of third-party dependencies.
